notes: The that opening the profanation clause is given to its waw under rule 55, a conjunction standing in the clause; it is not added.
The nor of the second prohibition is the waw-plus-negative fusion of rule 35, while the third clause's waw and lo' each take a word of their own and so are split by rule 2.
mum bo puts hath on the be- and he on the suffix under rule 43, no relative standing in this clause to supply the subject.
